Patient health records: daily challenge, 2027-02-28

The shared System Designer challenge for 2027-02-28: Patient health records. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

A hospital network keeps patient charts, orders, notes and scanned documents for 40 hospitals. Doctors need a chart in under a second, no saved note may be lost when a server or a building fails (in a whole-region disaster, at most the last minute of edits may need re-entering from the ward), and an auditor can walk in any day and ask you to prove who looked at what.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
